items.note: Applies only when the change's delta specs hold no ADDED or MODIFIED section.

params.label: Correctness
params.text: Not applicable (no ADDED or MODIFIED requirements)

sources.quote: For a change that only removes or renames requirements, the Correctness cell reads `Not applicable (no ADDED or MODIFIED requirements)`.

items.note: If a task was still open when the report was written, the report has to list it as a CRITICAL issue.
Only the Correctness dimension can be observed as skipped from cited labels; other dimensions are not covered.

sources.quote:
**Final Assessment**:
   - If CRITICAL issues: "X critical issue(s) found. Fix before archiving." If any check was skipped, also name every skipped check and its reason.

items.note: A skipped check shows up as Not verified in the Correctness cell; the report must not then claim it is ready for archive.

sources.quote: **Final Assessment**: ... "All checks passed. Ready for archive." ... If any check was skipped and there are no CRITICAL issues: do not claim readiness.

items.note: A round 2 (verify-2.md) means round 1 found CRITICAL issues; the apply document has to be reopened between the two reports.

sources.quote: Round 1 with one or more CRITICAL issues: open the apply stage document (`/opsx/stages/02-apply.md`) again and fix those CRITICAL items only

items.note: Needs the count of CRITICAL issues in the report to match the X in the final assessment; no predicate can read that count.

sources.quote: If no CRITICAL issues, one or more warnings, and no checks were skipped: "No critical issues. Y warning(s) to consider. Ready for archive (with noted improvements)."

items.note: The condition depends on issue counts by priority, which no predicate can read.

sources.quote: If only suggestions and no checks were skipped: "No critical issues or warnings. Z suggestion(s) to consider. Ready for archive (with noted improvements)."

items.note: The condition (no issues, no skipped checks across all dimensions) cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: If no issues and no checks were skipped: "All checks passed. Ready for archive."

items.note: Needs both 'a check was skipped' and 'no CRITICAL issues'; the second cannot be observed.

sources.quote: Say "No critical issues found in the checks that ran. <check(s)> not verified: <reason>."

items.note: Needs the number of WARNING issues in the report compared with the stated count.

sources.quote: Include the warning count when nonzero.

items.note: Needs the number of SUGGESTION issues in the report compared with the stated count.

sources.quote: Include the suggestion count when nonzero in every final assessment.

items.note: verify-2.md is required only when round 1 reported CRITICAL issues, and that condition cannot be observed. The ordering when verify-2 exists is covered by the vf-128 item.

sources.quote: Then come back to this document for round 2 (`verify-2.md`).

unitemized.reason: The WARNING group only exists when there are warnings, and putting an issue in it (spec/design divergence, missing scenario coverage) is a judgment call. The doc shows the group as a bold list, not a fixed heading, so no observable check is reliable.
The SUGGESTION group only exists when there are suggestions, and putting an issue in it (pattern inconsistencies, minor improvements) is a judgment call with no observable condition.
